item.title: About
item.description:
FirewallSync covers the parts of cybersecurity that actually change how engineering teams operate day to day — access control, incident response process, and secrets management — written for the people who have to implement it, not just the people auditing it.

We publish practical, field-tested writing rather than vendor-sponsored listicles. Got something worth writing about? Reach out via the Advertise page.

item.title: Advertise / Guest Post
item.description:
FirewallSync accepts a limited number of guest contributions from writers and agencies in the security and IT space.

What we’re looking for: original, specific writing on cybersecurity, IT operations, or engineering process — no thin AI-generated filler, no more than one contextual link back to your site.

What we don’t accept: gambling, adult, or unrelated affiliate content; guest posts with more than one promotional link; anything that reads like a press release.

item.title: Write for Us
item.description:
FirewallSync publishes practical, field-tested security writing for engineering teams — not vendor whitepapers, not listicles. If you’ve shipped a fix, run an incident, or built a process that actually held up under pressure, we want to hear about it.

What we publish

  • Postmortems and lessons learned (anonymized details are fine)
  • Concrete how-tos: rollout plans, tooling comparisons, architecture decisions
  • Opinionated takes on practices the industry treats as settled but shouldn’t

What we don’t publish

  • Generic “top 10 security tips” content
  • Thinly-veiled product pitches
  • Anything you can’t back with specifics

Byline & links

Accepted posts get a full author byline and one contextual link back to your site or profile. We don’t do paid placements or sponsored posts dressed up as articles — see our advertising page if that’s what you’re looking for instead.
